name: manual_b62135
claim: Capability bands change the collected set, not only the pass count: compare collected test ids between cells before reading a pass-count delta; a +16 passed result was +18 seam-positive and -2 seam-absent.

decisions.notes: Reproduced by counting tests per module at exact SHAs; the negative count was left explicitly unverified.

rationale: Reproduced by counting tests per module at exact SHAs; the negative count was left explicitly unverified.
